mu_name_from: MODEL_HELPER+3, Data/Player/Helper04.bmd, its sheet RedDragonT.OZJ from Data/Item. ITEM_HORN_OF_DINORANT, group 13 number 3. The bag icon; the ridden dragon is Rider02.
profile_note: A small held object seen in the bag: the weapon profile, as every misc item.
sheet_materials_from: A horn, painted gold. Judged from the sheet.

stats.note: The item's own row, from OpenMU's 0.95d initialiser: the Dinorant is not in 0.75 (Version075/Items/Pets.cs stops at 13/2). **After 0.75**, marked.
stats.call: this.CreatePet(3, SkillNumber.FireBreath, "Horn of Dinorant", 110, false, (Stats.IsDinorantEquipped, 1), (Stats.MovementSpeed, BasicMountMovementSpeed, Maximum), (Stats.MovementSpeedUnderwater, ...), (Stats.DamageReceiveDecrement, 0.9f, Multiplicate), (Stats.AttackDamageIncrease, 1.15f, Multiplicate))
stats.power_note: Damage dealt x1.15 and taken x0.9 (OpenMU 0.95d); WebZen's 1.00.93 takes 1 of the rider's life for each x1.15 blow and absorbs 10% (ObjAttack.cpp:1293-1328). Carries Fire Breath, skill 49, the knight's (WebZen public.h:224). Wears by damage/200 a hit taken (user.cpp:10623-10628). Made from ten 255-Life Horns of Uniria and a Jewel of Chaos at 70% (MixSystem.cpp:2156-2240), never dropped.
stats.classes_note: All classes may ride it; its skill is the knight's.
stats.level_note: 160, the user's (2026-10-02, asked whether to keep OpenMU's 110). The drop level follows, as CreatePet sets both from one number, so the shop's dropLevel^3 + 100 is 4,096,100.
stats.source_note: Sold on Lumen's shelf, the user's pick: there is no Chaos Machine to make it in (docs/mount.md).
